data.name: Astred
data.gender_notes: Astred is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Astred derives from Old Norse Óstréðr, composed of Ós (god) and tréðr (steadfastness). The name evokes the image of a noble warrior, steadfast in her faith and unwavering in her commitment to God. The name Astred carries the meaning “God's steadfastness, noble warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Astred usually hope their child will grow to embody god's steadfastness, noble warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of unwavering faith and steadfastness in the face of life's challenges.
